Command.description: An operator message sent through the operator link at `at`; payload keys are the message's field names.
Command.title: Command

EndCondition.description:
Ends at a time, on an observed operator message, or when the controller enters a state; never later than
`max_duration`.
EndCondition.title: EndCondition

EventCriterion.description: Presence or absence of an operator message or controller state within a window (SCO-022).
EventCriterion.title: EventCriterion

HoldBandCriterion.description:
Every listed joint stays within `band` of its first sample in the window (SCO-026): a hold that sags and rings
inside the band is not motion.
HoldBandCriterion.title: HoldBandCriterion

IntegritySettings.description:
The case's integrity section (INT-026, ADR 0010 amendment, round 5 ruling 4): `halt_on_crossing` true ends
the run at the first tier 1 limit crossing, false lets it run to its end; the case fails on a crossing either
way (INT-025). Absent or empty: false; nothing else sets it (round 5 rulings 4, 50).

halt_on_crossing.description: End the run at the first tier 1 crossing (INT-026).
halt_on_crossing.title: Halt On Crossing

IntegritySettings.title: IntegritySettings

IntervalCriterion.description: The simulated time from one recorded event to the next (SCO-021).
IntervalCriterion.title: IntervalCriterion

JointState.description: A single-DOF joint's start: a length and a speed (prismatic) or an angle and an angular rate (revolute).
JointState.title: JointState

NoMotionCriterion.description: No actuator motion above `threshold` within the window (SCO-023).
NoMotionCriterion.title: NoMotionCriterion

NoOverlapCriterion.description:
No two commands active at once on one actuator (SCO-025): the recorded `start_event` and `end_event`
occurrences whose detail names `actuator` pair in time order; a start before the previous end fails, and with
`closed` so does a start still unpaired when the run ends. Both refs are `event:` refs (firmware log events carry
the actuator; operator messages and states do not).
NoOverlapCriterion.title: NoOverlapCriterion

default.description: Value used when neither the case nor --set gives one (DES-044): a quantity string of the parameter's dimension, or a choice value
default.title: Default

dimension.description: pint dimensionality string, or "choice" for a non-quantity
dimension.title: Dimension

PayloadChange.description: Instantaneous: at `start` the payload on `target` becomes `mass`; 0 kg detaches it.
PayloadChange.title: PayloadChange

PhysicsSettings.description:
The run configuration's physics section (TST-040): `adapter` selects the physics adapter, `mujoco` by default
until X2 (ruling 41); `--set physics.adapter=<name>` overrides it.
PhysicsSettings.title: PhysicsSettings

Rates.description: Overrides of the design's rates for this case; at least one is given.
Rates.title: Rates

SettleCriterion.description: Time for a series to enter and stay in `band` around `target` (its final value when absent) (SCO-024).
SettleCriterion.title: SettleCriterion

Sweep.description: One run per value of a design parameter: `${name}` for an open parameter, else `<section>.<item>.<field>`.
Sweep.title: Sweep

ValueCriterion.description:
A statistic of a recorded series against a limit (SCO-020); `within` compares with `target` absolutely
(`limit`) or relatively (`relative_limit`).
ValueCriterion.title: ValueCriterion

Variation.description: A seeded spread about the nominal value: standard deviation (normal) or half width (uniform).
Variation.title: Variation

Variations.description:
`count` seeded variations (TST-026): variation k runs with its own integer seed, derived from the case seed
and k, which also draws each parameter's value about its nominal; rerun alone from that seed.
Variations.title: Variations

parameters.description: Values for open parameters of the design or the case (DES-044), and instance:<name>.<parameter> or instance:<name>.part overrides (LIB-016, LIB-017); --set overrides them
parameters.title: Parameters
